<<NOTES ON WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL>>

WHITEWASHING A CELLAR WALL IS A COMMON WAY TO PREPARE A WALL FOR NEW PLASTER OR TO MAKE IT LOOK CLEAN AND NEW. IT IS DONE BY APPLYING A THIN LAYER OF WHITEWASH OVER THE WALL, WHICH IS A MIXTURE OF WHITELIKE POWDER AND WATER. THIS PROCESS HELPED PREVENT THE WALL FROM GETTING DUSTY OR FROSTBENT IN WINTER. IT IS ALSO USED TO MAKE THE WALL LOOK MORE TIDY AND PREPARE IT FOR FUTURE DECORATION. SOME PEOPLE SAY IT IS A WAY TO MAKE THE CELLAR SMELL BETTER AND TO KEEP THE WALL FROM GETTING MOIST. IT IS A SIMPLE AND EASILY DONE TASK THAT CAN BE DONE BY ANYONE WITH A BIT OF TIME AND MATERIALS.
